metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in the async_task_completion family addressing exception inspection from Future objects. It differs semantically from peer candidates: Future Result Retrieval (result propagation), Future Completion Callback Registration (non-blocking notification), and Submit Callable (task dispatch). No existing skill in the registry covers exception() method with timeout handling. Existing skills are unrelated (reward computation, GRPO loss). Candidate has valid support evidence and no conflicts.
